title: Sibling clients and settings
what: The settings in explorer/settings.toml and the clients of bmo-agency, bmo-receiver, bmo-artifact, bmo-gate, bmo-node and the tool host's control socket, each by its documented routes. Lives in src/clients/ and src/settings.rs.

title: Unit command
what: The bmo-explorer program: its nouns for the browse and remote-browser launches and runners and the unread-pages list, and the version. Lives in src/main.rs and src/lib.rs.

title: Unread pages list
what: bmo-explorer tool unread-pages: the pages no road read, a site at a time out of the store, each beside the site tool the tool host names. Lives in src/unread.rs.
